Life:Be-Born: : whenever a PERSON Entity is given birth to.
Life:Marry: : where two people are married under the legal definition.
Life:Divorce: : whenever two people are officially divorced under the legal definition.
Life:Injure: : whenever a PERSON Entity experiences physical harm.
Life:Die: : whenever the life of a PERSON Entity ends.
Movement:Transport: : whenever an ARTIFACT (WEAPON or VEHICLE) or a PERSON is moved from one PLACE (GPE, FACILITY, LOCATION) to another.
Transaction:Transfer-Ownership: : the buying, selling, loaning, borrowing, giving, or receiving of artifacts or organizations.
Transaction:Transfer-Money: : the giving, receiving, borrowing, or lending money when it is not in the context of purchasing something
Business:Start-Org: : whenever a new ORGANIZATION is created.
Business:Merge-Org: : whenever two or more ORGANIZATION Entities come together to form a new ORGANIZATION Entity
Business:Declare-Bankruptcy: : whenever an Entity officially requests legal protection from debt collection due to an extremely negative balance sheet.
Business: End-Org: : whenever an ORGANIZATION ceases to exist
Conflict:Attack: : a violent physical act causing harm or damage.
Conflict:Demonstrate: : whenever a large number of people come together in a public area to protest or demand some sort of official action.
Contact:Meet: : whenever two or more Entities come together at a single location and interact with one another face-to-face.
Contact:Phone-Write: : when two or more people directly engage in discussion which does not take place ‘face-to-face’
Personnel:Start-Position: : whenever a PERSON Entity begins working for (or changes offices within) an ORGANIZATION or GPE.
Personnel:End-Position: : whenever a PERSON Entity stops working for (or changes offices within) an ORGANIZATION or GPE
Personnel:Nominate: : whenever a PERSON is proposed for a START-POSITION Event by the appropriate PERSON, through official channels.
Personnel:Elect: : whenever a candidate wins an election designed to determine the PERSON argument of a START-POSITION Event.
Justice:Arrest-Jail: : whenever the movement of a PERSON is constrained by a state actor.
Justice:Release-Parole: : whenever a state actor ends its custody of a PERSON Entity.
Justice:Trial-Hearing: : whenever a court proceeding has been initiated for the purposes of determining the guilt or innocence of a PERSON, ORGANIZATION or GPE accused of committing a crime or whenever a state actor officially gathers to discuss some criminal legal matter.
Justice:Charge-Indict: : whenever a PERSON, ORGANIZATION or GPE is accused of a crime by a state actor or whenever a state actor takes official legal action to follow up on an accusation.
Justice:Sue: : whenever a court proceeding has been initiated for the purposes of determining the liability of a PERSON, ORGANIZATION or GPE accused of committing a crime or neglecting a commitment.
Justice:Convict: : whenever a TRIAL Event ends with a successful prosecution of the DEFENDANT-ARG.
Justice:Sentence: : whenever the punishment for the DEFENDANT-ARG of a TRIAL Event is issued by a state actor
Justice:Fine: : whenever a state actor issues a financial punishment to a GPE, PERSON or ORGANIZATION Entity, typically as a result of court proceedings.
Justice:Execute: : whenever the life of a PERSON is taken by a state actor.
Justice:Extradite: : whenever a PERSON is sent by a state actor from one PLACE
Justice:Acquit: : whenever a trial ends but fails to produce a conviction.
Justice:Appeal: : whenever the decision of a court is taken to a higher court for review.
Justice:Pardon: : whenever a head-of-state or their appointed representative lifts a sentence imposed by the judiciary.
